environment.working_tree: uncommitted single persistent Deno worker, tests and updated benchmark harness

methodology.latency: Same three workloads; 3 rounds of 210 requests + 7 warmups; precompiled binaries; alternating order. deno is the new persistent worker; deno-per-call is the preserved original prototype binary.
methodology.rss: Separate 70 measured + 7 warmup calls; ~1ms macOS libproc sampling of whole process-tree RSS. Shared pages may be counted twice, and sub-ms spikes can be missed.
methodology.first_request: Steady-state latency excludes process startup during warmup. Deno startup probe remains a separate launch/ready/teardown measurement.
methodology.soak: See separate JSON traces: 180 seconds mixed workload (7 rules + date conversion), minimum 5ms between starts, then 30s idle; ~100ms RSS sampling; no per-call latency arrays during soak.
methodology.binary_hash_note: Hashes identify preserved per-call binary and final soak-capable probes; the latency probe preceded addition of idle observation flags, with unchanged production worker and measured RunCode loop.
